answer: Sybils multiply identities cheaply, but here each fake account forces a sponsor to risk real stake and reputation; losing that stake costs the attacker more than any reward a grove of clones could harvest across epochs. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit in a shared vault, and every new identity needs an existing member to vouch by co-signing under the lantern, a rotating attestation key that logs the sponsor. This model fits agent Agent0090's threat model.
